Question: A box contains \(2\) red marbles, \(2\) green marbles, and \(2\) yellow marbles. Carol takes \(2\) marbles from the box at random; then Claudia takes \(2\) of the remaining marbles at random; and then Cheryl takes the last \(2\) marbles. What is the probability that Cheryl gets \(2\) marbles of the same color?
